capabilities: create a timestamped journal Markdown file via command
configure the folder new journal pages go into
open the new page in the active pane
assign a hotkey to the command
disambiguation: Not a journaling system with templates or entries; it only creates one empty timestamped file per command run.
extras: The Obsidian listing carries a notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; missing parent folders are created automatically on first write.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command for quickly creating a journal page whose filename includes the exact creation time, not just the date.
summary: Command that creates an empty Markdown file named journal_YYYYMMDDHHmmss.md in a chosen folder and opens it.
